title: Testing Common Causality of Covariates: Evidence from Private-Sector Ban-the-Box Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.29148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When including covariates in Difference-in-Differences, researchers must consider not only which covariates to include, but also how to model them. The Common Causality of Covariates (CCC) assumption requires that covariate coefficients in the untreated potential-outcome model remain constant across regions and periods. Violations can bias DID estimators even when the relevant covariates are correctly included. I develop a CCC test based on Wald tests from an additive model that uses untreated observations in pre-treatment periods to assess whether covariate coefficients vary across regions, periods, or both. Motivated by this specification problem, I show theoretically that well-specified Integrated DID estimators are consistent, whereas overly restrictive models can introduce bias and, under conditional homoskedasticity, unnecessarily flexible models can reduce efficiency. translated_title: 检验协变量的共同因果性：来自私营部门“禁止勾选框”政策的证据
translated_abstract: 当在双重差分法（DID）中纳入协变量时，研究者不仅需要考虑纳入哪些协变量，还需要考虑如何对其进行建模。协变量共同因果性（Common Causality of Covariates, CCC）假设要求，在未处理状态下的潜在结果模型中，协变量的系数在不同地区和不同时期之间保持不变。即使相关协变量被正确纳入，该假设一旦被违反，仍可能导致双重差分估计量产生偏差。作者基于加法模型的Wald检验开发了一种CCC检验方法，利用处理前时期的未处理观测值来评估协变量系数是否在地区、时期或两者之间存在变异。基于这一模型设定问题的动机，作者从理论上证明，设定良好的综合双重差分估计量是一致的，而过度受限的模型可能引入偏差；在条件同方差性下，过于灵活的模型则会降低估计效率。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该CCC检验具有良好的检验水平（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Wald检验、用于检验双重差分法中协变量共同因果性（CCC）假设的新方法，并从理论和蒙特卡洛模拟两方面证明设定良好的综合DID估计量具有一致性，而模型设定过严会引入偏差、过松则会降低效率，并以私营部门“禁止勾选框”政策为实证应用场景。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a Wald-test-based procedure for testing the Common Causality of Covariates (CCC) assumption in Difference-in-Differences, showing theoretically and via Monte Carlo simulations that well-specified Integrated DID estimators are consistent, while overly restrictive models introduce bias and overly flexible models reduce efficiency, with an application to private-sector Ban-the-Box policies.
